subject: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: vendor@olivemfg.com, procure-support@olivemfg.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification

Hi Chris / Olive team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the supplier onboarding for Olive Manufacturing — welcome aboard. I attached our completed onboarding form (olive_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) and the W-9 you sent earlier. A couple of items came up while validating your submission against our vendor master: 

- Address mismatch: The billing address on the W-9 differs from the address you provided on the form (PO address vs. corporate HQ). Please confirm the correct remit-to address for POs/invoices.
- Potential duplicate records: We found two existing supplier IDs that appear to reference Olive Manufacturing (SUP-00918 and SUP-03102). To avoid duplicate payments we need your confirmation on whether these are the same legal entity.
- Banking proof: We need a bank letter or voided check with the exact account name and routing/account numbers to complete ACH setup.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm the remit-to/billing address and whether SUP-00918 and SUP-03102 are the same entity (if yes, which supplier ID should be canonical).
2) Upload bank_letter_olive_2026.pdf or a clear voided check to the Drive link below.
3) Once we have bank verification we will request Marcus to merge/update the master record and remove the duplicate. POs will remain on hold until banking is verified.

Drive link for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Olive-Onboarding-Docs
Estimated timeline: with documents in hand, we aim to clear the account and enable POs within 2 business days.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: olive_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_OliveMfg_2026.pdf

From: vendor@olivemfg.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procure-support@olivemfg.com
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification

Hi Laura — thanks for the quick review.

A few clarifications:
- The billing/remit-to address should be: 742 Orchard St, Unit 4, Portland, OR 97214. Our HQ address (listed on the W-9) is 2100 Hollis Ave, Suite 300. Use the Orchard St address for invoices/PO remittance.
- SUP-00918 was an old trading entity (Olive Mfg LLC). SUP-03102 is our current vendor ID (Olive Manufacturing Inc.). They are effectively the same company following the 2024 reorg; we want SUP-03102 to be the canonical record.
- Attached bank_letter_olive_2026.pdf and a scanned voided check (voided_check_olive.png). The account name is "Olive Manufacturing Inc." and should match the vendor legal name for ACH.

I uploaded both files to the Drive folder and attached them here as well. Let me know if you need the letter on bank letterhead with a stamped bank signature — we can request that from our bank if required.

Best,
Chris Delgado
Operations Lead
Olive Manufacturing
vendor@olivemfg.com
+1 (503) 555-6620

Attachments: bank_letter_olive_2026.pdf, voided_check_olive.png

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification

Laura / Steph — reviewed Chris's response and the uploaded docs. Quick notes: 

- Bank docs look acceptable for initial ACH setup but do a quick scan for name/account number OCR errors. If everything matches, I will instruct Finance to update the supplier master and map SUP-00918 -> SUP-03102 (merge with SUP-03102 as canonical).
- Please create a short MR in our procurement tracker with: vendor canonical ID (SUP-03102), old ID (SUP-00918), files uploaded, and the recommended change. Put a hold note on any open POs referencing SUP-00918 pending confirmation of the merge to prevent misrouting payments.
- If the vendor wants to expedite payments while we merge, we can process a one-time wire (requires additional bank contact verification). Otherwise we should hold POs until the master is clean.

I'll coordinate with AP after Laura files the MR.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: vendor@olivemfg.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification

Hi Chris — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the docs. A couple of small asks before we finalize: 

- Can you confirm the exact legal name you want on Redwood's vendor record (as it should appear on contracts and 1099/1098 forms)? You indicated "Olive Manufacturing Inc." — please reply to confirm.
- Please confirm the SUP-03102 identifier is the canonical one to keep; we'll merge SUP-00918 into SUP-03102.
- For the bank letter: please confirm it contains the routing and account numbers and the bank contact name; if not, request the stamped letter from the bank.

I opened a merge request in our procurement tracker: https://procure.redwood.ai/mr/merge-sup-00918-03102 (you will not need access, internal reference only). Once you reply I will mark the MR ready and ask Marcus to push the change.

Action items for Olive: 1) Confirm canonical legal name; 2) Confirm SUP-03102 to keep; 3) Confirm bank letter has routing/account/bank contact.

Regards,
Laura
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: procure-support@olivemfg.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, vendor@olivemfg.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: data amendments, duplicate records & banking verification

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Confirming on behalf of Olive Manufacturing: 
- Canonical legal name: "Olive Manufacturing Inc." (confirmed).
- Keep SUP-03102 as the canonical supplier ID and merge SUP-00918 into it.
- The uploaded bank_letter_olive_2026.pdf includes routing/account numbers and the bank contact name (Clara Benton, Treasury Officer). The bank can also provide a stamped letter if Redwood requires that for higher payment limits.

We have also initiated the DocuSign envelope for the vendor master update and ACH authorization (link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/3f2a-olive-onboard). Please let us know when the merge is complete so we can confirm the first PO.

Thanks,
Procurement Support
Olive Manufacturing
procure-support@olivemfg.com

Attachments: none
